key_insight: AlgoRAG shows that a domain-tuned RAG system can deliver correct, pedagogically useful explanations for difficult theoretical computer science topics like proofs and complexity.
engineering_relevance: The paper demonstrates a practical template for building adaptive educational assistants by combining curated domain knowledge with notation-aware retrieval and pedagogical ranking.
method: Curated TCS knowledge base: textbooks, lecture slides, practice problems, proof templates, and worksheets
Added mathematical entity recognition, notation-aware retrieval, and pedagogical re-ranking
Evaluated on 179 exam-style questions across core algorithm analysis and complexity topics
evidence_signal: On 179 curated questions, AlgoRAG reports 100% success, 38.0 s mean response time, ROUGE-1 F1 of 0.0963, ROUGE-L F1 of 0.0683, and pedagogical quality of 0.7620.
watch_item: BLEU-4 is zero, highlighting that n-gram metrics can miss mathematically equivalent solutions and that the system still needs careful human evaluation for proof quality.
paper_title: AlgoRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Theoretical Computer Science Education -- A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for Algorithm Analysis and Complexity Theory
